prompt.en: According to the Karnataka government's circular discussed in the High Court, what specific information are all hospital pharmacies mandated to disclose on bills?

text.en: Only the maximum retail price of medicines and surgical items.

explanation.en:
The excerpt explicitly states that the circular mandates hospital pharmacies to disclose both the landing base/purchase price and the maximum retail price of medicines, medical devices, and consumables on bills.
Source: https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/karnataka/will-not-enforce-circular-on-hospital-medicine-price-disclosure-for-now-karnataka-government-to-hc/article71645843.ece

prompt.en: The development of India's regional satellite navigation system NavIC originally commenced in the aftermath of which major historical conflict?

prompt.en: What is the primary mechanism of the experimental gene therapy CRMA-1001 in treating the hepatitis B virus?

It utilizes synthetic enzymes to completely dissolve the viral outer protein coat.

The excerpt highlights that CRMA-1001 is promising because, instead of targeting the virus directly, it silences the viral DNA to prevent virus rebound.
